about: Connecticut state grant calls entered by hand from each program's own page: Connecticut has no state catalog here (docs/state-coverage.md), so this is not a statewide list. grantmatch/local.py checks this file and turns each entry into a Connecticut program record; the weekly page watcher rereads every page. Change an entry only from the official page, and update its checked date.

programs.title: Connecticut Arts Endowment Fund Grant
programs.objectives: General operating support for Connecticut arts organizations, usable for programming, administrative or operational costs, capital projects, equipment or the organization's own endowment.
programs.who: Connecticut-based arts organizations with 501(c)(3) status that are in good standing with the Secretary of the State, have an active charity registration, spend at least 51% of their yearly expenses on arts activities and raised more than $15,000 in private-sector donor contributions for their two most recently completed fiscal years. First-time applicants confirm eligibility with the program manager before applying.
programs.application: Apply online in the Connecticut Office of the Arts e-granting portal.
programs.award: The amount isn't stated on the pages read.
programs.source_note: One Arts Office page still says the program is closed; it is dated March 2025 and refers to the December 15, 2024 deadline.
programs.subjects: Arts; Culture; General operating support; Endowment

programs.title: Nonprofit Grant Program, Round 9
programs.agency: Connecticut Office of Policy and Management
programs.objectives: Capital grants to health and human service nonprofits for building alterations, renovations and new construction, health, safety, accessibility and energy improvements, information technology, vehicles and property. Paid as reimbursement.
programs.who: Private nonprofit health and human service organizations with 501(c)(3) status that receive state funds, including Medicaid, to provide direct health or human services to Connecticut agency clients, and are registered with CTsource.
programs.application: Register in the state's EUNA Grants system and apply there, after reading the program guidelines.
programs.award: The amount isn't stated on the pages read. Paid as reimbursement.
programs.deadlines: Round 9 applications close January 5, 2027 at 4:00 p.m. Eastern.
programs.subjects: Health; Human services; Capital improvements; Equipment; Vehicles; Accessibility
